days.title: Summit and Southern Slopes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Schütt
stops.detail: The Schütt on the southern slope of the mountain is the largest landslide area in the Eastern Alps and is described as a melting pot of nature.

stops.name: Gipfel des Dobratsch
stops.detail: The summit of the Dobratsch is easily accessible for families with children during a leisurely winter hike.

days.title: Mining Heritage and Underground Worlds
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Stollenwanderweg
stops.detail: The Stollenwanderweg is a circular hiking trail and was established by idealists from the Mining Cultural Association.

stops.name: Terra Mystica
stops.detail: The underground world can be visited in Terra Mystica and Terra Montana.

stops.name: Erzberges
stops.detail: It leads along the Erzberg and offers insights into the mining tradition of the Bleiberg Valley through old tunnels.

days.title: Educational Theme Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Maibacherl
stops.detail: On this circular hiking trail, numerous display boards designed by children explain the nature of the region with its plants and animals; furthermore, the hiker learns interesting facts about hiking in the footsteps of the Romans along the Roman road, and a special feature is the “Maibacherl” – a seasonal thermal water spring right next to the path.

stops.name: Bienenlehrpfad
stops.detail: Together with the students of the Dobratsch Nature Park school – VS Arnoldstein, the beekeeping association, the Dobratsch Nature Park, and the market town of Arnoldstein, a public bee educational trail was established.
